prompt: In what year was the former South Korean prime minister who is from the same clan as the oldest member of the band BTS born?
answer: The oldest BTS member is **Jin (Kim Seok-jin)**, who belongs to the **Gwangsan Kim clan**. Former South Korean Prime Minister **Kim Hwang-sik**, also of the Gwangsan Kim clan, was born in **1948**.
